title: Red Hat Security Advisory: mingw-expat security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in the mingw-expat packages, a port of the Expat XML parsing library for MinGW. These include several denial of service flaws, an XML injection vulnerability, and an information disclosure issue. The vulnerabilities stem from crafted XML input, quadratic complexity in attribute processing, XML external entity parsing, malformed UTF-16 input, heap buffer over-read, delayed entity amplification detection, NULL pointer dereference, and integer overflow during XML attribute parsing. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing these issues in their CodeReady Linux Builder for x86_64 8 product.
